title: Ask for help before the problem becomes a private project
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: State the desired outcome — Explain what should happen and what happens instead.; Supply useful evidence — Include safe context and checks that narrow the issue.; Name the help needed — Ask for diagnosis, explanation, access, or ownership.; Test and close the loop — Report the result and preserve the useful answer..
